replies.What is your relationship with mathemati: Mathematics has always been a bit daunting for me compared to physics and chemistry, which I love more. Since my parents didn't have higher education, I sometimes feel self-conscious about academic subjects that require strong abstract thinking. However, I appreciate its utility in real life.
replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Yes, sometimes. My low conscientiousness and neuroticism make me worry if I'm missing something or failing. When topics get too theoretical, I prefer to step back and focus on things that are more tangible, like sports or hiking.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: I tried using it for explanations once. It felt a bit cold and impersonal. Since I prefer art and literature over abstract concepts, I found the technical jargon overwhelming. I'd rather ask friends or teachers who can explain things more intuitively.
